[Appium]计时节点的回放日志显示开始计时、记录时间点或结束计时操作，以及计: [Appium] The playback log of the timing node displays the start timing, recording time point or end timing operation, as well as the timer name and ID, retaining the original time and time-consuming data.
[Appium]搜索节点支持输入纯数字按显示序号精确定位，主画布与流程总览同步生: [Appium] The search node supports inputting pure numbers to accurately locate according to the display sequence number. The main canvas and process overview take effect simultaneously, and text searches for names, operations, positioning content and logs are retained.
[兼容]旧命令每次启动均联网检查并运行 qualix@latest，自动跟随后续: [Compatible] The old command checks and runs qualix@latest on the Internet every time it is started, automatically follows subsequent major version upgrades, and retains startup parameters, working directories, application environment variables, and exit codes; when the check or download fails, an error is clearly reported and exited.
[数据]继续沿用原有用户数据目录、环境变量和浏览器存储键，已有脚本、配置及界面状: [Data] Continue to use the original user data directory, environment variables and browser storage keys. Existing scripts, configurations and interface status do not need to be migrated.
[Appium]新增通用“计时打点”操作，支持开始、记录任意阶段和结束；通过系统: [Appium] Added a new universal "timing point" operation, which supports starting, recording any stage and ending; it is associated with the timer ID generated by the system.
[Appium]“获取随机值”节点支持选择已有全局或私有预设变量；缺少变量时可前: [Appium] The "Get Random Value" node supports the selection of existing global or private preset variables; when variables are missing, you can go to add and return to continue configuration to simultaneously protect sensitive candidate content.
[Appium]新增“获取随机值”操作节点，支持预设文本及 TXT 抽取、随机整: [Appium] Added "Get Random Value" operation node, which supports preset text and TXT extraction, random integers and UUID.
[Appium]修复横向流程中展开节点及内部折叠选项时连接点偏移的问题。: [Appium] Fixed the problem of connection point offset when expanding nodes and internal folding options in horizontal flow.
[Appium]优化节点展开编辑性能，复用未变化节点的配置，仅测量发生变化的节点: [Appium] Optimize node expansion editing performance, reuse the configuration of unchanged nodes, measure only changed nodes, and reduce repeated rendering and entire image rearrangement.
[Appium]配置页新增“基础配置”和“模型配置”分组，归并流程外观、回放及: [Appium] The configuration page adds "Basic Configuration" and "Model Configuration" groups to merge process appearance, playback and AI-related settings.
[Appium]流程布局新增横向显示，默认为纵向。: [Appium] A new horizontal display is added to the process layout, and the default is vertical.
[Appium]流程外观配置新增多套预设主题，可统一调整画布背景、节点填充、节点: [Appium] Added multiple sets of preset themes to the process appearance configuration, which can uniformly adjust the canvas background, node filling, node border and connection line color; support custom colors, restore default and dark node text adaptation, and the main canvas and process overview take effect simultaneously.
[Appium]整理流程外观配置界面，统一布局方向、连接线样式等切换按钮，采用紧: [Appium] Organize the process appearance configuration interface, unify the layout direction, connection line style and other switch buttons, and adopt a compact theme and color configuration layout.
[Appium]节点编辑配置统一采用左右排列，优化各类节点的选项间距与折叠分组；: [Appium] Node editing configuration adopts a unified left and right arrangement, optimizing the option spacing and folding grouping of various nodes; folded items are changed to instant expansion, merged size updates and reduced repeated measurements, reducing lag caused by rearrangement of the entire image and automatic focusing.
[Appium]修复新增节点后画布自动回到居中的问题，保留当前插入位置和缩放比例: [Appium] Fixed the problem of the canvas automatically returning to the center after adding a node, retaining the current insertion position and zoom ratio, and maintaining the editing and expansion state of the original node.
[Appium]修复元素判断临近超时时误报“设备自动化服务无响应”的问题。: [Appium] Fixed the problem of falsely reporting "Device Automation Service Not Responding" when element condition is approaching timeout.
[Appium]流程编辑器新增直线与曲线切换，默认使用曲线，配置自动保存并同步至: [Appium] A new line and curve switch is added to the process editor. Curve is used by default. The configuration is automatically saved and synchronized to the main canvas and process overview.
[Appium]优化多分支汇合线：汇合点按左右汇入线居中，增大纵向间距，曲线在底: [Appium] Optimize multi-branch merging lines: When merging, click the left and right merging lines to center them, increase the vertical spacing, and the curves merge smoothly at the bottom blank space to reduce node occlusion.
[Appium]优化流程画布交互：点击节点自动放大并居中，流程总览支持还原位置，: [Appium] Optimize process canvas interaction: click on a node to automatically enlarge and center it, the process overview supports restoring the position, and the AI recognition node prompt words can display up to three lines.
[Appium]统一节点编辑界面：AI 识别、组件定位、节点信息和超时设置使用紧: [Appium] Unify the node editing interface: AI recognition, component positioning, node information and timeout settings use compact grouping to optimize the layout of parameters such as looping, sliding, and zooming.
[Appium]组件树搜索支持上下切换匹配项，组件详情按优先级展示定位方式和组件: [Appium] Component tree search supports switching matching items up and down, and component details display positioning methods and component attributes according to priority.
[AI识别]分支提示词校验增加开放式输出说明和具体修改建议。: [AI Recognition] Add open output instructions and specific modification suggestions for branch prompt word verification.
[配置/UI]修复 API Key 显示按钮，统一提示弹窗、选项控件及相关配置区: [Configuration/UI] Fix the API Key display button and unify the prompt pop-up window, option control and related configuration area styles.
[Appium]修复持续刷新页面中的操作超时，以及可选元素未出现时误报失败的问题: [Appium] Fixed the operation timeout in continuous page refresh and the issue of false positive failure when optional elements did not appear.
[Appium]脚本列表支持批量导入并自动重建连接脚本关系；导入后保留列表页，不: [Appium] The script list supports batch import and automatically rebuilds the connection script relationship; the list page is retained after import and the scripts are not automatically loaded.
[Appium]点击节点改为优先使用组件定位，失败后才使用备用坐标；节点配置中显: [Appium] When clicking a node, component positioning will be used first, and alternative coordinates will be used only after failure; alternative coordinates are displayed in the node configuration and invalid areas are filtered.
[Appium]优化连接脚本参数和返回值配置，使用自适应卡片布局并简化空状态。: [Appium] Optimize connection script parameters and return value configuration, use adaptive card layout and simplify empty states.
[Appium]修复登录等点击操作已经触发 Activity 跳转后，UiAut: [Appium] Fixed the problem that after a click operation such as login has triggered an Activity jump, UiAutomator2 still waits for click confirmation, eventually falsely reporting a timeout and occupying the command queue; element clicks first read the real-time area, then click the center coordinates through ADB, and limit the idle waiting time of the interface.
[Appium]修复登录等点击操作已经触发 Activity 跳转后，持续动画或: [Appium] Fixed the problem that after click operations such as login have triggered Activity jump, continuous animation or frequent interface events still make UiAutomator2 wait for a long time, and eventually falsely report click timeout; limit the idle waiting time of the interface to avoid the command queue being occupied for a long time.
修复长时间执行 ADB 操作、延时或 AI 识别后，Appium 因默认 60: Fixed an issue where Appium destroyed the session due to the default 60-second command idle timeout after long-term execution of ADB operations, delays, or AI recognition, causing subsequent Home key, click, and other nodes to report "invalid session id"; the hosting service turned off the session idle timer, and the external service kept alive through heartbeats and retained 60 seconds of idle recycling to avoid leaving permanent sessions after the creation request was canceled or the cleanup failed.
为启动 App、清理数据、坐标点击与滑动补齐 ADB 超时和取消控制；终止前台检: Complete ADB timeout and cancellation control for starting the App, cleaning data, coordinate clicks and sliding; no longer continue to start the App after terminating the foreground check, and still clean up the session after an abnormal end.
修复远程回放固定 10 分钟超时后丢失结果的问题：任务随代理心跳续期，离线任务支: Fixed the problem of losing results after a fixed 10-minute timeout in remote playback: tasks are renewed with the agent heartbeat, offline tasks support termination and resubmission of history records after the connection is restored, and result reporting failures are automatically retried and the script will not be executed repeatedly.
修复远程设备无法手动终止回放的问题，通过独立心跳传递取消信号，兼容任务派发前取消: Fixed the problem that the remote device could not manually terminate playback. The cancellation signal was transmitted through an independent heartbeat, compatible with cancellation before task dispatch, and prevented the same device from submitting playback repeatedly.
修复配置加载失败后出现空白可保存表单的问题，增加独立错误提示和重试；后端断线后自: Fixed the problem of a blank saveable form appearing after configuration loading failure, and added independent error prompts and retries; the backend automatically tries to reconnect after disconnection and supports manual reconnection, retaining the page editing content.
Appium 配置自动保存失败后保留最新待保存内容并提供“重试保存”；修复切换或: After the Appium configuration fails to automatically save, it retains the latest content to be saved and provides "retry saving"; fixes the problem that after switching or closing the Appium tab, the unsaved draft protection fails when leaving the page.
Appium 顶部工具栏改为随页面布局排列，窄屏自动换行，避免遮挡面包屑；统一全: The top toolbar of Appium is changed to be arranged according to the page layout, and the narrow screen automatically wraps lines to avoid blocking breadcrumbs; the whole site style and Chinese component copywriting are unified, and repeated theme statements are merged.
完善隔离数据环境下的浏览器回归测试，以及请求校验、配置保护、自动保存重试和统计口: Improve browser regression testing in an isolated data environment, as well as request verification, configuration protection, automatic save retry and statistical caliber testing.
侧边栏底部新增“帮助与版本”入口。: A new "Help and Version" entry is added at the bottom of the sidebar.
AI 识别预设提示词支持编辑测试场景名称和提示词内容，默认预设与自定义预设均可修: AI recognition preset prompt words support editing the test scene name and prompt word content. Both default presets and custom presets can be modified and automatically saved.
AI 识别启用分支后可勾选“启用兜底”，再选择进入左侧 true 或右侧 fal: After AI recognition enables the branch, you can check "Enable Digging", and then choose to enter the true branch on the left or the false branch on the right; normal recognition results will not be affected.
新增独立的“提示词优化模型”，统一用于优化 AI 识别提示词、报告提示词和生成回: A new independent "prompt word optimization model" is added, which is uniformly used to optimize AI recognition prompt words, report prompt words and generate playback test report summaries; both AI recognition and playback reports can input brief requirements and then the model will supplement the prompt words, and the model test will be changed to a pop-up prompt.
回放设置新增报告模板选择，不选择时使用默认测试报告；开启报告总结后会在回放前检测: A new report template selection is added to the playback settings. If not selected, the default test report will be used; after the report summary is turned on, the prompt word optimization model will be detected before playback. When the model is unavailable, a pop-up window will prompt and continue to generate a basic report in the default format. When the summary request fails, times out, or returns empty content, the basic report will still be retained and the test results will not be changed.
回放输出弹窗支持同时拖拽调整宽度和高度，并保留最小尺寸与窗口边界限制。: The playback output pop-up window supports drag-and-drop adjustment of width and height at the same time, while retaining the minimum size and window boundary constraints.
连接脚本列表显示同一 App 的其他已保存脚本，不再因入口 Activity 不: The connection script list displays other saved scripts of the same App, which are no longer hidden because the entry Activity is different or unbound; when selected, it indicates the behavior of waiting for the entry page or executing directly from the current screen.
点击坐标操作新增“获取点击坐标”，直接在左侧设备预览点击画面即可填入实际 X、Y: "Get click coordinates" is added to the click coordinate operation. You can directly click on the device preview screen on the left to fill in the actual X and Y coordinates. No pop-up window is required. Cancellation is supported. Taking points will not perform device operations.
修复回放终止或会话创建失败后设备端 UiAutomator2 残留，导致组件树刷: Fixed an issue where device-side UiAutomator2 remains after playback is terminated or session creation fails, causing component tree refresh to fail.
AI 持续观察新增“检测命中后提前结束”模式，边采样去重边识别，命中后停止观察并: AI continuous observation adds a new "early end after detecting a hit" mode, sampling and deduplication while identifying. After a hit, stop observation and continue the process or enter the "Yes" branch; after reaching the maximum observation time, complete the remaining keyframe condition, if there is no hit, go to the original sequence or "No" branch, and support hit condition verification, cancellation and sequential model request timeout.
Appium 参数的AI 识别配置，新增持续观察选项，支持 pixelmatch: AI recognition configuration of Appium parameters, new continuous observation option, support pixelmatch (default), OpenCV (SSIM) and no duplication option.
AI 识别新增“持续观察”，可设置观察时长与采样间隔，按时间顺序采集多帧后统一判: AI recognition has added "Continuous Observation", which can set the observation duration and sampling interval. After collecting multiple frames in chronological order, it can be uniformly judged whether the target has appeared or the content has been read. Observation and model timeout are timed separately. Cancellation, sampling logs and test screen previews are supported. The original single-frame recognition remains compatible.
新增 AI 识别默认顺序执行模式，模型回答写入日志后继续下一节点；勾选“启用分支: The new AI recognizes the default sequential execution mode. The model answer is written to the log and then continues to the next node; when "Enable branching" is checked and branch questions are modified, the semantics are judged through model verification. If it is not consistent, it will prompt and the branch modification will not be saved.
Appium 配置新增默认关闭的“截图与 HTML 报告”开关；开启后才采集节点: Appium configuration adds a new "Screenshot and HTML report" switch that is turned off by default; it must be turned on to collect screenshots before and after the node and generate HTML.
修复部分华为设备录屏启动时报编码器错误的问题：使用设备默认编码参数，视频流启动失: Fixed the problem of encoder error when starting screen recording on some Huawei devices: use the device's default encoding parameters, reduce the resolution and bit rate and try again when the video stream fails to start, and output diagnostic logs for each attempt.
开启录屏时，在 Appium 服务端日志结束后汇总所有录像片段的脚本名称和保存位: When screen recording is turned on, the script names and saving locations of all video clips will be summarized after the Appium server log ends; a clear prompt will appear when no video is generated.
录屏启动失败、录像不完整或保存失败时，日志明确提示对流程执行的影响并提供排查建议: When screen recording fails to start, the recording is incomplete or fails to be saved, the log clearly indicates the impact on process execution and provides troubleshooting suggestions, while retaining the original error information.
回放录屏支持按连接脚本分段保存 MP4，返回父脚本继续执行时另存片段；历史结果可: The playback screen recording supports saving MP4 segments according to the connection script, and saving segments when returning to the parent script to continue execution; historical results can be played in segments, and HTML reports automatically switch videos according to node time. When deleting historical results, all segments are cleared together.
scrcpy 视频帧完整性修复：可靠传输视频包、修正关键帧标记，并在缓冲溢出后等: scrcpy video frame integrity repair: reliably transmit video packets, correct keyframe marks, and wait for complete keyframe recovery after buffer overflow, reducing the risk of device preview blur.
回放按钮右侧下拉设置新增默认关闭的“录制回放视频”，远程设备暂不支持。: The drop-down setting on the right side of the playback button has added "Record and Playback Video" that is turned off by default, which is not supported by remote devices.
图像模板判断改为“预期匹配结果”，匹配严格度以百分比配置，100% 时提示细微像: The image template condition is changed to "expected matching results", and the matching strictness is configured in percentage. At 100%, the risk of subtle pixel differences is prompted; the node displays the expected results, and the log and HTML report display the actual matching, expected matching, score and conditional conclusion respectively, and the original detection algorithm and existing thresholds are retained.
移除 AI 识别操作、测试入口及 Appium 参数中的 AI 模型配置，保留流: Remove the AI recognition operation, test entry, and AI model configuration in Appium parameters, and retain the process background color settings; AI node prompts in the old script are replaced, execution is blocked before playback, and branches are not automatically deleted or changed.
移除节点类型切换；新节点及未配置的判断等待超时统一为 3000ms，已有自定义时: Node type switching is removed; new nodes and unconfigured condition waiting timeouts are unified to 3000ms, and existing custom time and delay, long press and other operation durations remain unchanged.
取消 Activity 不匹配时的脚本编辑锁定，不在脚本绑定页面也可编辑节点；页: Cancel the script editing lock when the activities do not match, and you can edit nodes without the script binding page; the page differences are only a reminder, and the editing protection during recording operations and playback is retained.
所有分支节点新增“超时后处理”，可预设终止流程、进入左侧或右侧分支，默认终止；覆: All branch nodes have added "timeout post-processing", which can preset the termination process, enter the left or right branch, and terminate by default; covering element waiting, text matching, check control waiting, AI recognition and image observation timeout, logs and HTML reports indicate timeout branches. Normally false, the upper limit of the number of cycles and the timeout are handled separately, and the device will still be terminated if the device is disconnected or Appium becomes unresponsive.
修复元素查找超时未覆盖 Appium 请求的问题，驱动无响应时及时中止并明确报错: Fixed the problem of element search timeout not covering Appium request. When the driver becomes unresponsive, it will stop in time and clearly report an error. It will no longer misjudge that the element cannot be found; unique native positioning will give priority to ID or Accessibility ID.
设备预览新增设备信息，展示设备名称、品牌、型号、处理器、Android 版本、物: The device preview adds device information, showing the device name, brand, model, processor, Android version, physical resolution and current resolution, and supports remote devices; the question mark is located on the right side of the title, and the style is consistent with the global variable help icon.
新增独立“杀死 APP”操作节点，默认使用当前选中应用包名，支持编辑目标包名；停: Added an independent "Kill APP" operation node, which uses the currently selected application package name by default and supports editing the target package name; stops the application process under the current device user without clearing application data.
新合并支持取消：原合并按钮切换为取消合并，还原分支和被删除的重复节点，保留配置编: The new merge supports cancellation: the original merge button is switched to cancel the merge, the branches and deleted duplicate nodes are restored, and the configuration edits are retained; the new common operations in the public process can choose to retain the left side, the right side, or both sides, and prevent restoration when there is a structural conflict. Restore records are saved locally, and export and node replication do not carry historical records.
启动相册前先停止当前设备用户下的目标相册进程，再重新打开；保留相册自动适配，不清: Before starting the album, stop the target album process under the current device user and then reopen it; keep the album automatically adapted, do not clear photos and application data, and clearly report an error when the stop fails.
修复修改元素或父级定位后仍使用旧备用定位、画面变化像素容差无法设为 0 的问题。: Fixed the issue where the old backup positioning is still used after modifying element or parent positioning, and the pixel tolerance of screen changes cannot be set to 0.
新增“图像判断”分支节点，支持本地 OpenCV 模板匹配、图片勾选双模板、黑屏: A new "Image Condition" branch node is added, which supports local OpenCV template matching, image selection of double templates, black screen, area color and multi-frame change detection; supports component positioning, frame selection area, template collection and upload, continuous sampling and true/false branches, and clearly reports that the decision cannot be made when there is insufficient evidence. HTML reports display metrics and zoomable detection images, protected by sensitive run screenshots.
合流后的公共节点上方新增插入入口，支持新增和粘贴操作，所有汇入分支先执行新操作再: A new insertion entrance is added above the merged public node to support new and paste operations. All incoming branches first perform new operations before entering the original public node.
修复嵌套判断显式合流到外层公共节点时连接被过滤、公共节点提前排列的问题，支持跨层: Fixed the issue where connections were filtered and public nodes were arranged in advance when nested condition was explicitly merged to an outer public node, and cross-layer branch merging was supported.
修复同一分支内显式跳转被画布误画为顺序连接的问题，失效跳转目标不再错误连接到相邻: Fixed the issue where explicit jumps within the same branch were mistakenly drawn as sequential connections on the canvas, and failed jump targets are no longer incorrectly connected to adjacent nodes.
修复判断分支默认返回公共后续节点时画布漏连线、节点重叠的问题，嵌套分支显示与回放: Fixed the problem of missing connections and overlapping nodes in the canvas when the condition branch returns to the public subsequent node by default, and the nested branch display is consistent with the playback path.
操作菜单移除“断言存在”和“断言文本”，统一保留“判断存在”及其文本匹配配置；旧: The operation menu removes "Assert Existence" and "Assert Text", and uniformly retains "Assert Existence" and its text matching configuration; assertion nodes in old scripts are still compatible with the original execution behavior.
“点击坐标”节点支持编辑 X、Y 坐标，保存后回放使用新坐标；默认节点名称同步更: The "Click Coordinates" node supports editing X and Y coordinates, and the new coordinates will be used for playback after saving; the default node name is updated simultaneously, and the custom name remains unchanged.
新增“预设变量”区域，支持全局变量和脚本私有变量，输入、判断、定位和日志支持 {: A new "Default Variables" area is added, which supports global variables and script private variables. Input, condition, positioning and logs support {{variable name}} references.
添加画面变化结束节点时，多组可配对检测支持按名称及开始节点编号选择，允许交叉结束: When adding a screen change end node, multiple groups of paired detection support selection by name and start node number, allowing cross ending; when there is only one group, add it directly, retaining branches and repeated end verification.
画面变化结束节点校验覆盖祖先及子分支：同一执行路径已存在对应结束节点时，后续分支: Screen change end node verification covers ancestors and sub-branches: when the same execution path already has a corresponding end node, subsequent branches cannot be added repeatedly; mutually exclusive branches can still be ended separately.
脚本列表新增“历史结果对比”：保存运行结果、应用版本、设备、截图和日志，支持筛选: Added "Historical Results Comparison" to the script list: saves running results, application versions, devices, screenshots and logs, supports filtering to view pass rate, time-consuming trend and failed node distribution, compares two runs and deletes the selected history; manual termination will not be counted in the pass rate, and old reports will not be automatically added.
画面变化检测在每个结束节点执行后立即对比本次截图，避免循环及重复调用脚本时多组检: Screen change detection compares the current screenshot immediately after each end node is executed to avoid multiple sets of detection reusing the last round of pictures when looping and repeatedly calling the script; when a screenshot is missing, an exception is clearly reported and the old picture is not used to replace it.
“启动 APP”支持在流程中途、判断分支及循环体内多次添加，按所选位置执行；连接: "Start APP" supports adding multiple times in the middle of the process, condition branches and loop bodies, and executes according to the selected position; the connection script only skips the application initialization at the beginning, and the startup operation in the middle is retained normally.
组件详情展示 Resource ID、Accessibility ID、XPat: The component details display the four positioning contents of Resource ID, Accessibility ID, XPath and UiAutomator, which support copying separately to facilitate the configuration of loop exit conditions; if the corresponding attributes are missing, it will be displayed as not provided.
“流程控制”新增有界循环及退出循环：支持固定次数、元素出现或消失时退出，必须设置: "Process Control" adds new bounded loops and exit loops: it supports a fixed number of times and exits when elements appear or disappear. The maximum number of executions must be set; the loop body supports nested conditions, confluences and connection scripts. The exit node can select the current or outer loop. When exiting the outer loop, the inner loop will be ended at the same time and the target loop end path will be executed directly. The log and HTML report will mark the round and exit target.
新增流程节点搜索，支持按名称、操作类型、定位内容和日志关键字筛选，展示所属分支并: A new process node search is added, which supports filtering by name, operation type, positioning content and log keywords, displays the branches and switches between multiple results; the ordinary canvas and process overview support positioning highlighting, without changing the node layout and batch selection status.
录制工作区支持拖拽调整设备预览、组件树栏宽，自动保存布局并支持恢复默认。: The recording workspace supports dragging and dropping to adjust device preview and component tree column width, automatically saves the layout, and supports restoring to default.
新增节点批量删除功能，支持多选节点，选中节点及所属子节点以柔和红色背景和浅色文字: A new node batch deletion function is added, which supports multi-selection of nodes. Synchronous operation of normal and enlarged views is supported.
判断节点新增“合并分支”，支持选择一侧公共流程起点，将两侧后续汇入同一段居中流程: A new "Merge Branch" is added to the condition node, which supports the selection of the starting point of a common process on one side and merges both sides into the same intermediate process; the other side can retain unique operations or confirm the deletion of duplicate suffixes, and supports nested conditions and various branches. The public node is only executed once and will not be deleted along with the node on one side.
将 Checkbox、RadioButton 判断入口合并为“判断勾选”，新增: Merge the Checkbox and RadioButton condition entrances into "Condition Check", and add Switch support; automatically verify component types and checkable attributes when adding and playing back, read the real-time checked status and enter the true / false branch, without changing the control status, and is compatible with existing independent condition nodes.
“流程控制”新增终止流程节点，执行到该节点时主动结束本次回放，不再执行后续节点或: "Process Control" adds a new termination process node. When the node is executed, it will actively end the playback and no longer execute subsequent nodes or connection scripts. When the child script is triggered, the entire process will also end, and the execution log and report will be retained. It will not be regarded as an execution failure.
“设备操作”新增启动相册顺序节点，优先解析系统相册入口，必要时查找已安装的常见相: "Device Operation" adds a new node for starting the photo album sequence, giving priority to parsing the system photo album entry, and searching for installed common photo album applications if necessary; only opening the photo album, not selecting photos, and recording the actual startup application in the log, and clearly reporting an error when it is not found or fails to start.
Appium 配置新增流程背景色设置，默认沿用浅绿色，支持预选颜色、颜色选择器、: Appium configuration adds a new process background color setting, which is light green by default. It supports pre-selected colors, color pickers, #RGB / #RRGGBB input checksums and restores to default; it is persisted after saving, and the normal canvas, enlarged view and connection script preview are uniformly applied.
Appium 配置中的流程背景色独立成区，与节点模型配置分开展示，保留预选颜色、: The process background color in the Appium configuration is an independent area and is displayed separately from the node model configuration. Preselected colors, custom colors and save entries are retained.
“组件操作”新增文字点击分支节点，无需预选元素，支持精准匹配和模糊匹配原生组件文: "Component Operation" adds a new text click branch node, no need to pre-select elements, supports exact matching and fuzzy matching of native component text; after matching and clicking, it enters "Matching text", if it times out and fails to find it, it enters "Unmatched text". Supports text editing and timeout, multi-element matching and click exception clear error reporting, logs and reports retain branch results.
“流程控制”新增输出日志节点，支持设置日志内容和自定义关键字，默认按 stage: "Process Control" adds a new output log node, which supports setting log content and custom keywords. By default, it is output according to stageLog: content; it supports editing after adding, and the log content is retained during playback of real-time output, log files and reports, and keywords are added line by line to multi-line content.
新增 AI 识别判断节点，可输入按钮可用、画面黑屏等识别要求，通过当前设备截图返: A new AI recognition condition node is added. You can enter recognition requirements such as button availability and black screen. Return true / false through the current device screenshot and enter the corresponding branch; Appium configuration supports independent setting of Base URL, API Key, Model Name and test model. The model must support image input.
长按操作新增元素模式，新建节点默认按元素定位执行长按；添加弹窗和节点配置支持切换: A new element mode is added to the long press operation. New nodes perform long press according to element positioning by default. Added pop-up windows and node configurations support switching element/coordinate mode and modifying the long press time. The old script retains the coordinate long press behavior.
新增原生 Checkbox 和 RadioButton 状态判断节点，添加时校验: Add native Checkbox and RadioButton status condition nodes, verify the selected element type when adding, read the checked attribute during playback, and press true / false to enter the corresponding branch without changing the check status; component details display the native check attribute, and the playback log and report record the condition results.
新增脚本列表复制和重命名能力，可直接生成“原文件名 Copy”副本并修改脚本名称: Added script list copy and rename capabilities, which can directly generate a copy of "original file name copy" and modify the script name, making it easier to reuse existing recording processes.
新增检测画面变化能力，支持框选设备预览区域或使用当前选中元素作为检测区域，通过“: Added the ability to detect screen changes, support frame selection of the device preview area or use the currently selected element as the detection area, and compare the differences between the before and after screenshots in the same branch through "Detect Screen Change N-Start Node/End Node".
检测画面变化结果写入 Markdown 和 HTML 回放报告，展示检测区域、阈: The results of detecting screen changes are written into Markdown and HTML playback reports, which display the detection area, threshold, maximum change ratio, reference frame, comparison frame and difference map. HTML images support clicking to enlarge the view.
新增空节点，用于在顺序流程中作为无操作占位节点，配合画面变化检测或流程编排使用。: A new empty node is added, used as a no-operation placeholder node in the sequence process, and used in conjunction with screen change detection or process orchestration.
优化流程图节点插入、删除、复制、缩放和判断分支布局，修复节点新增后连线延迟、缩放: Optimize the insertion, deletion, copying, scaling and condition branch layout of flowchart nodes, and fix problems such as connection delays after adding nodes, invisible nodes after scaling, disordered branches after deleting detection nodes, and repeated addition of the same end node.
回放报告截图和截图节点改为使用 ADB 截图，避免 Appium /screen: Playback report screenshots and screenshot nodes are changed to use ADB screenshots to avoid blocking the UiAutomator2 command queue after Appium /screenshot times out; a more accurate timeout prompt will also be displayed when Appium request times out.
修复流程节点复制与粘贴问题，避免 structuredClone 失败、粘贴后原: Fixed the problem of copying and pasting process nodes to avoid structuredClone failure, disappearance of the original node after pasting, incorrect branch insertion position, and relative position deviation after copying.
修复判断分支已有节点时入口添加按钮缺失的问题，分支入口现在会保留可插入节点，并正: Fixed the issue where the entry add button is missing when judging that a branch already has nodes. The branch entry will now retain insertable nodes and be correctly connected to the first branch node.
滑动操作支持在添加弹窗和节点配置中修改起点、终点坐标及滑动时长。: The sliding operation supports modifying the starting point, end point coordinates and sliding duration in adding pop-up windows and node configurations.
长按操作支持设置长按时间，并在节点卡片中显示长按坐标和时长。: The long press operation supports setting the long press time, and displays the long press coordinates and duration in the node card.
Android 设备预览恢复使用 scrcpy 实时流，优化实时流参数，减少 H: Android device preview resumes using scrcpy real-time stream, optimizes real-time stream parameters, and reduces screen blur caused by H.264 frame loss; when refreshing the screen, the underlying Playground preview stream will be restarted and wait for the session to be ready.
测试脚本生成新增提示词模板，可在通用提示词、广告测试、表单填写、聊天对话、播放器: The test script generates a new prompt word template, which can switch between general prompt words, advertising testing, form filling, chat dialogue, player testing, search list, order payment, permission pop-up window, personal settings and H5/WebView, and supports editing or uploading the current original Prompt.
优化 AI 生成流程，支持后台处理和终止生成；生成中锁定原始 Prompt，再次: Optimize the AI generation process and support background processing and termination of generation; lock the original prompt during generation, click "AI Generation" again to restore the progress pop-up window, and no additional prompts will pop up after termination.
优化脚本生成提示词策略，区分广告、播放器、弹窗等被测目标与无关遮挡内容，登录流程: Optimize the script generation prompt word strategy to distinguish tested targets such as advertisements, players, and pop-up windows from irrelevant blocked content. The login process adds blocked pop-up window processing after login and successful determination of the unblocked homepage.
参数配置的运行配置新增保存校验，Android SDK 路径必须包含 platf: A new save verification has been added to the running configuration of parameter configuration. The Android SDK path must include platform-tools/adb, and the playback report directory must be an absolute path that already exists and can be written.
常见问题拆分为独立 FAQ.md 文档，并在 README 的“功能文档”中增加: The frequently asked questions are split into independent FAQ.md documents, and a jump entry is added to the "Function Document" of README.
录制步骤流程图升级为独立画布与节点卡片视图，优化节点内容排版、操作图标、选中态、: The recording step flow chart has been upgraded to an independent canvas and node card view, and the node content layout, operation icon, selected state, batch copy and restore location experience have been optimized.
统一普通流程线、操作按钮连线和判断分支线条样式，按节点实际高度计算连接位置，修复: Unify the styles of ordinary flow lines, operation button connections and branch condition lines, calculate the connection position according to the actual height of the node, and repair the problems of line color inconsistency, breakage, redundant lines, node overlap and branch misalignment.
优化判断分支布局，统一“是 / 否”分支的 T 形连接样式，避免分支节点堆叠、左: Optimize the condition branch layout and unify the T-shaped connection style of "yes/no" branches to avoid stacking of branch nodes, confusing left and right branch connections, and an extra third branch.
连接脚本支持只读预览，使用眼睛图标打开预览弹窗，预览内容居中展示，修改仍需加载脚: The connection script supports read-only preview. Use the eye icon to open the preview pop-up window. The preview content is displayed in the center. Modifications still need to be done after loading the script.
连接脚本回放时会跳过子脚本开始后的重复“启动 App”和“清除 App”操作，减: When the connection script is played back, the repeated "Start App" and "Clear App" operations after the start of the child script will be skipped, reducing repeated initialization during cross-script connections.
移除“连接到下一节点”“取消连接”“继续主流程”等冗余连接操作，保留复制节点作为: Remove redundant connection operations such as "Connect to the next node", "Cancel the connection" and "Continue the main process", and retain the replication node as the main reuse method.
修复放大面板后点击操作按钮或节点配置会重置缩放的问题，保持当前画布大小和位置。: Fixed an issue where clicking the action button or node configuration after zooming in on the panel would reset the zoom, maintaining the current canvas size and position.
Appium 流程支持单节点、连续节点及完整判断子流程的复制与粘贴。: The Appium process supports copying and pasting of single nodes, continuous nodes, and complete condition sub-processes.
优化判断分支布局和流程总览，支持在总览中编辑完整流程。: Optimize the condition branch layout and process overview, and support editing of the complete process in the overview.
Appium session 与“启动 APP”节点解耦，并避免将桌面、设置等系: Appium session is decoupled from the "Launch APP" node and avoids misidentification of system activities such as desktop and settings as script entries.
修复复杂判断脚本加载失败及加载后无法进入“当前录制”的问题。: Fixed the problem of complex condition script failing to load and being unable to enter "Current Recording" after loading.
回放输出支持保留完整 Appium 服务日志，并可在执行过程中手动终止。: Replay output supports retaining the full Appium service log and can be manually terminated during execution.
新增单文件 HTML 截图回放报告，提供时间轴、步骤导航和连续播放效果。: Added single-file HTML screenshot playback report, providing timeline, step navigation and continuous playback effect.
使用说明和更新记录自动嵌入 README，可直接在 npm 页面渲染查看。: Instructions for use and update records are automatically embedded in the README and can be viewed directly on the npm page.
新增在线文档查看入口，支持渲染使用说明和更新记录。: A new online document viewing portal has been added to support rendering instructions and update records.
优化参数配置页面布局，将预设 App 参数归入运行配置区域。: Optimize the layout of the parameter configuration page and classify the preset App parameters into the running configuration area.
参数配置支持指定 Android SDK 和回放报告目录，并在回放前检查 And: Parameter configuration supports specifying the Android SDK and playback report directory, and checking the Android SDK before playback.
回放完成后生成包含节点配置、执行结果和日志的 Markdown 报告。: After the playback is completed, a Markdown report containing node configuration, execution results and logs is generated.
脚本列表支持 JSON 脚本导入和下载。: The script list supports JSON script import and download.
设备预览接入 scrcpy 实时画面，组件树可随页面和 Activity 变化自: The device preview is connected to the scrcpy real-time screen, and the component tree can be automatically refreshed as the page and activity change.
回放输出改为实时流式日志，并增强 UIAutomator 并发和异常恢复能力。: Playback output is changed to real-time streaming logs, and UIAutomator concurrency and exception recovery capabilities are enhanced.
判断分支支持文本匹配、连接不同 Activity 的脚本及连接后的主流程回放。: The condition branch supports text matching, connecting scripts of different activities and main process playback after connection.
新增节点备注、未保存提醒和页面状态持久化。: Added node notes, unsaved reminders and page status persistence.
修复历史脚本新增节点后无法覆盖保存的问题。: Fixed the problem that the historical script could not be overwritten and saved after adding new nodes.
修复连接脚本未按顺序继续执行的问题。: Fixed an issue where connection scripts were not continuing in sequence.
“启动 APP”统一为流程开始节点操作，每个脚本最多添加一次。: "Start APP" is unified as the process start node operation, and each script can be added at most once.
连接脚本回放时自动跳过子脚本的重复启动操作。: Automatically skip repeated startup operations of child scripts when connecting to script playback.
修复 npm 页面中的更新记录访问链接。: Fix update record access link in npm page.
npm 包新增项目更新记录，并清理未随包发布的内部文档链接。: The npm package adds project update records and cleans up internal document links that are not published with the package.
录制步骤升级为可拖动、缩放和编辑的流程图，支持“是 / 否”判断分支。: The recording steps are upgraded to draggable, zoomable, and editable flowcharts that support "yes/no" branching.
支持在流程任意位置插入操作，并编辑节点、定位器、超时和输入内容。: Supports inserting operations anywhere in the process and editing nodes, locators, timeouts, and input content.
支持 Activity 跳转检测和单 Activity 脚本录制保护。: Supports Activity jump detection and single Activity script recording protection.
支持连接已保存脚本，组合登录、首页等跨页面测试流程。: Supports connecting saved scripts and combining login, homepage and other cross-page testing processes.
新增脚本管理列表，可加载、删除和回放已录制脚本。: Added a new script management list to load, delete and play back recorded scripts.
新增 selector 唯一性检测和父级上下文定位，解决多个组件共用同一 ID: Added selector uniqueness detection and parent context positioning to solve the problem of multiple components sharing the same ID.
回放支持多级定位和坐标兜底，并记录页面检查点与完整失败诊断信息。: Playback supports multi-level positioning and coordinate retrieval, and records page checkpoints and complete failure diagnostic information.
新增存在则点击、输入、清空、返回等可选操作。: If there is a new addition, click, enter, clear, return and other optional operations.
新增等待出现、判断存在和等待消失等等待与判断能力。: Added waiting and condition capabilities such as waiting to appear, judging existence, and waiting to disappear.
新增可复用设备预览，支持点击画面选择组件树节点和刷新实时画面。: Added a new reusable device preview that supports clicking on the screen to select component tree nodes and refreshing the real-time screen.
组件树支持滚动浏览并展示当前 Activity。: The component tree supports scrolling and displays the current activity.
录制操作统一通过“添加操作”菜单选择。: The recording operation is selected through the "Add Operation" menu.
首次提供 Appium 无模型录制与回放能力。: For the first time, Appium model-free recording and playback capabilities are provided.
支持从组件树录制点击、输入、断言和延时，并保存为可回放脚本。: Supports recording clicks, inputs, assertions, and delays from the component tree and saving them as replayable scripts.
App 包名与参数配置中的预设 App 统一管理。: App package names and default apps in parameter configuration are managed uniformly.
更新后脚本或配置不见了怎么办: What should I do if the script or configuration is missing after updating?
通常不是数据被删除，而是旧版本把数据保存到了启动命令所在目录。新版 npx qu: Usually it is not that the data is deleted, but that the old version saves the data to the directory where the startup command is located. The new version of npx qualix will use the fixed system user data directory by default and try to automatically migrate old data from the current directory at startup.
Qualix 沿用更名前的数据目录，无需迁移已有脚本和配置。: Qualix continues to use the data directory before the name change, so there is no need to migrate existing scripts and configurations.
同一个 id 定位到错误输入框怎么办: What should I do if the same id is positioned in the wrong input box?
如果账号框和密码框都是 id/tg_edit，只按 id 回放可能输入到第一个输: If the account box and password box are both id/tg_edit, only the id playback may be entered into the first input box.
直接分别选择账号框和密码框录制输入。: Directly select the account box and password box respectively to record the input.
在节点详情里确认 selector 是否显示“重复 N”，以及“推荐定位”是否显: In the node details, confirm whether the selector displays "Duplicate N" and whether "Recommended positioning" displays parent + child.
如果推荐定位不准确，展开录制步骤，手动修改父级上下文 selector。: If the recommended positioning is inaccurate, expand the recording step and manually modify the parent context selector.
坐标点击只作为最后兜底。: Clicking on the coordinates is only used as a last resort.
点击后没有检测到页面跳转怎么办: What should I do if the page jump is not detected after clicking?
App 使用单 Activity，Activity 不变化。: App uses a single Activity, and the Activity does not change.
页面跳转依赖网络。: Page jumps depend on the network.
使用“等待出现”判断下个页面核心元素，或添加“等待 Activity”明确目标页: Use "Wait for Appearance" to determine the core elements of the next page, or add "Wait for Activity" to clarify the target page.
检测到 Activity 变化时可以选择继续在当前脚本录制；也可以拆成两个脚本，: When activity changes are detected, you can choose to continue recording in the current script; you can also split it into two scripts and then use "Connect Script" to connect them in series.
单 Activity App 不要依赖 Activity 变化，应使用页面核心元: Single Activity App should not rely on Activity changes, but should use the core elements of the page to determine whether it has entered the target state.
连接脚本后为什么没有进入目标页面: Why do I not enter the target page after connecting to the script?
连接脚本列表会显示同一 App 的其他已保存脚本，不受入口 Activity 限: The connection script list will display other saved scripts of the same App, regardless of the entry activity.
连接操作本身不会点击页面或主动跳转，前面的点击、输入或启动 App 必须先让设备: The connection operation itself will not click on the page or actively jump. The previous click, input or startup of the app must first let the device enter the page required by the target script.
目标脚本绑定了入口 Activity 时，回放会等待该 Activity；未绑定: When the target script is bound to the entry Activity, the playback will wait for the Activity; if it is not bound, it will be executed directly from the current screen.
跨页面连接前建议添加“等待 Activity”或“等待出现”，便于确认页面已经切: It is recommended to add "Wait for Activity" or "Wait for Appearance" before connecting across pages to confirm that the page switching has been completed.
为什么在桌面点击 App 后回放无效: Why is the playback invalid after clicking the App on the desktop?
部分厂商系统会限制桌面或启动器页面的控件信息，Appium 可能无法获取桌面图标: Some manufacturers' systems limit the control information on the desktop or launcher page, and Appium may not be able to obtain the stable ID of the desktop icon. At this time, "clicking the App icon" recorded on the desktop may not be played back.
建议在开始节点后添加“启动 App”操作，由系统按包名打开目标 App，替代桌面: It is recommended to add the "Start App" operation after the start node, and the system will open the target App according to the package name, instead of clicking the icon on the desktop. When you need to reset the login status or cache, you can first add "Clear App Cache" and then add "Start App".

不建议把登录按钮、提交按钮、核心断言设置为可选。: It is not recommended to make login buttons, submit buttons, and core assertions optional.
回放时出现 UiAutomation not connected 怎么办: What to do if UiAutomation not connected appears during playback
组件树刷新和 Appium 回放不能同时占用 UiAutomation。当前版本: Component tree refresh and Appium playback cannot occupy UiAutomation at the same time. The current version pauses automatic component tree refresh during playback and retries after cleaning up residual fetching processes when disconnected.
确认手机保持解锁，USB 调试授权没有失效。: Confirm that the phone remains unlocked and the USB debugging authorization has not expired.
确认 Appium 和 UiAutomator2 Driver 已正常启动。: Confirm that Appium and UiAutomator2 Driver have started normally.
停止其他正在抓取同一设备组件树的工具。: Stop other tools that are crawling the same device component tree.
重新连接设备后再次回放。: Reconnect the device and play again.

先确认设备仍显示在设备下拉框中。: First make sure the device is still displayed in the device drop-down box.

在测试脚本生成页面切换到“自定义步骤编排”，可以逐条添加操作、等待、查询和判断步: Switch to "Custom Step Arrangement" on the test script generation page, and you can add operation, waiting, query and condition steps one by one. Each instruction only describes a clear target, and observable page elements are used as wait conditions after the page jumps.
生成脚本后可以查看、编辑或复制代码。确认内容后点击“保存脚本”，保存的脚本会出现: After generating the script you can view, edit or copy the code. After confirming the content, click "Save Script", and the saved script will appear on the "Automated Testing" page.
脚本运行期间点击顶部“停止执行”可以中止后续步骤。停止后查看执行输出，确认最后完: While the script is running, click "Stop Execution" at the top to abort subsequent steps. After stopping, view the execution output to confirm the last completed step and the stopping position.
自动化测试页面会实时显示步骤状态、耗时和错误信息。执行失败时先检查模型配置、AD: The automated test page will display step status, time consumption and error information in real time. If the execution fails, first check whether the model configuration, ADB connection, device screen, and target description in the instruction are clear.
一条指令只完成一个目标；输入、点击和等待尽量拆分；等待条件应描述页面中可观察到的: One instruction only completes one goal; input, click and wait should be split as much as possible; waiting conditions should describe the stable elements that can be observed on the page; do not handle a large number of pop-up windows and business operations at the same time in the same step. When component IDs are stable and require a lot of repeated playback, you can use the Appium process instead.

回放报告目录：填写 Markdown 回放报告的保存目录。支持绝对路径；相对路径: Playback report directory: Fill in the directory where the Markdown playback report is saved. 在“开始”节点或任意步骤后的“插入操作”中选择要录制的操作。: Select the action you want to record in the Start node or Insert Action after any step.
在“录制步骤”中检查流程、编辑节点备注并配置判断分支。: Check the process, edit node notes, and configure decision branches in Recording Steps.
输入脚本名称并保存。: Enter a name for the script and save it.
选择已保存脚本后点击“回放”。: Select the saved script and click "Playback".
App 包名是必填项，只能从“参数配置”中已经添加的“预设 App 参数”选择，: The App package name is required and can only be selected from the "Default App Parameters" added in "Parameter Configuration" and cannot be entered manually. Operations cannot be recorded when no app is selected.
点击预览中的组件后，组件树会定位并选中对应节点，默认同时显示组件边框。: After clicking a component in the preview, the component tree will locate and select the corresponding node, and the component border will be displayed by default.
实时流不可用时会自动使用 ADB 截图轮询，避免两种画面来源相互覆盖。: When live streaming is unavailable, ADB screenshot polling is automatically used to prevent the two screen sources from overwriting each other.
画面停止更新时，可点击设备预览工具栏中的刷新按钮重新获取画面。: When the screen stops updating, you can click the refresh button in the device preview toolbar to reacquire the screen.
首次进入页面、切换设备、Activity 变化或页面结构变化后，组件树会自动刷新: The component tree will automatically refresh after entering the page for the first time, switching devices, activity changes, or page structure changes.

注意：Appium 回放和组件树抓取都会占用 Android UiAutomat: Note: Appium playback and component tree grabbing both consume Android UiAutomation. The system will execute serially according to the device and automatically retry after cleaning up the remaining processes when the connection is preempted.

点击“放大”打开流程总览；总览中同样可以点击节点编辑。: Click "Enlarge" to open the process overview; you can also click on nodes to edit in the overview.
点击节点后的“插入操作”可在任意步骤中间新增操作。: Click "Insert Operation" after the node to add an operation in the middle of any step.

浏览器刷新后会保持当前功能页面和 Appium 工作区 Tab；存在未保存修改时: After the browser is refreshed, the current function page and Appium workspace tab will be maintained; if there are unsaved modifications, you will be prompted to save before refreshing or closing the page.
录制点击后如果检测到 Activity 发生变化，系统会提示选择继续录制或结束并: If activity changes are detected after clicking the recording button, the system will prompt you to choose to continue recording or end and save. 跨页面流程建议在跳转操作后添加“等待 Activity”，明确目标页面并提高回放: For cross-page processes, it is recommended to add a "waiting activity" after the jump operation to clarify the target page and improve playback stability. 设备操作：点击坐标、系统返回、Home 键、最近任务、电源键、滑动、双指缩放、启: Device operations: click coordinates, system return, Home button, recent tasks, power button, slide, pinch to zoom, start APP, stop APP, start photo album, clear APP data.
判断与等待：判断存在、判断勾选、文字点击、AI 识别、图像判断、等待出现、等待消: Condition and waiting: Condition of existence, condition of check, text click, AI recognition, image condition, waiting to appear, waiting to disappear, waiting for Activity.
检测画面变化：在三级菜单中分别添加“开始”和“结束”，对比指定区域前后的画面。: Detect picture changes: Add "Start" and "End" to the three-level menu respectively, and compare the pictures before and after the specified area.
循环：添加有界循环、进入下一次循环和退出循环。进入下一次循环会跳过本轮剩余节点；: Loops: Add bounded loops, enter next loop, and exit loop. Entering the next loop will skip the remaining nodes of this round; exiting the loop will execute the process after the end of the target loop.
流程控制：连接脚本、终止流程、输出日志和添加延时。: Process control: connect scripts, terminate processes, output logs and add delays.
旧脚本中的“断言存在”和“断言文本”仍可回放，但新流程统一使用当前菜单中的判断与: The "Assert Existence" and "Assert Text" in the old script can still be played back, but the new process uses the condition and wait operations in the current menu uniformly.
读取选中组件的文字或属性并保存为脚本变量，后续输入、判断、定位和日志节点可以使用: Read the text or attributes of the selected component and save it as a script variable. Subsequent input, condition, positioning and log nodes can be referenced using {{variable name}}.
停止指定包名的 App 进程，不卸载应用，也不清除登录信息和本地数据。节点中可以: Stops the App process of the specified package name without uninstalling the app or clearing login information and local data. The target package name can be modified in the node.
打开设备可用的系统相册或常见相册应用，只负责进入相册，不自动选择照片或视频。: Open the system album or common album application available on the device. It is only responsible for entering the album and does not automatically select photos or videos.
清除目标应用数据并恢复初始状态，会删除登录信息和本地设置。该操作只允许放在流程开: Clearing target application data and restoring the original state will delete login information and local settings. This operation can only be placed at the beginning of the process, and you should confirm that the test data can be reset before use.
读取原生 Checkbox、RadioButton 或 Switch 的真实 c: Read the true checked status of the native Checkbox, RadioButton or Switch, and enter the corresponding branch according to checked or unchecked. Ordinary picture controls should use image condition instead.
按指定文字精确或模糊查找原生组件，匹配后点击并进入成功分支，未匹配时进入另一分支: Search the native component precisely or fuzzyly according to the specified text. If it matches, click and enter the success branch. If there is no match, it will enter another branch. It does not recognize text in pictures or self-drawn screens.
将设备截图发送给视觉模型，可以执行单帧识别、持续观察或检测命中后提前结束。默认按: Send device screenshots to the vision model to perform single-frame recognition, continuous observation, or early termination after detecting a hit. 使用本地 OpenCV 判断模板、图片勾选状态、黑屏、区域颜色或多帧变化，不调用: Use local OpenCV to determine the template, picture check status, black screen, area color or multi-frame changes without calling the model. Fixed icons and stable visual characteristics are suitable for this operation.
从三级菜单分别添加“开始”和“结束”。开始节点保存指定区域的基准截图，结束节点与: Add "Start" and "End" respectively from the third level menu. The start node saves the baseline screenshot of the specified area, the end node compares it with the corresponding baseline and records the change results in logs and reports.
在最大执行次数范围内重复执行循环体，可以固定次数运行，也可以根据元素出现或消失提: The loop body is repeatedly executed within the maximum number of executions. It can be run a fixed number of times, or it can exit early according to the appearance or disappearance of elements. The maximum number of times is used to prevent the script from looping infinitely.
跳过当前轮剩余节点并进入指定的当前或外层循环下一轮。达到最大次数后执行循环结束路: Skip the remaining nodes of the current round and enter the next round of the specified current or outer loop. The execution loop ends the path after reaching the maximum number of times.
立即结束指定的当前或外层循环，随后执行该循环结束后的流程。: Immediately ends the specified current or outer loop, and then executes the process after the end of the loop.
主动结束整次回放，后续节点和连接脚本不再执行。系统仍会保存本次日志和报告。: Actively end the entire playback, and subsequent node and connection scripts will no longer be executed. The system will still save this log and report.
输出自定义内容和日志关键字，支持 {{变量名}}。适合标记测试阶段、记录读取值或: Output custom content and log keywords, support {{variable name}}. Ideal for marking test phases, recording readings, or providing retrieval identifiers for reports.

用途：判断某个组件或指定文本是否出现，并根据结果走不同分支。它可以用于弹窗，也可: Purpose: Determine whether a certain component or specified text appears, and take different branches based on the results. It can be used for pop-up windows, but also for common page components such as buttons, list items, and prompt copy.
选择目标组件上的稳定元素，例如标题、按钮、列表项或提示文案。: Choose a stable element on the target component, such as a title, button, list item, or tooltip copy.
点击判断节点，按需填写“指定文本”。: Click the condition node and fill in the "specified text" as needed.

如果两个分支后续要执行相同操作，可以复制公共节点到对应分支，或把公共流程拆成“连: If two branches want to perform the same operation later, you can copy the common node to the corresponding branch, or split the common process into a "connection script" for reuse.
未配置指定文本时，只判断目标组件是否存在。: When the specified text is not configured, only whether the target component exists is judged.
配置指定文本后，会同时检查组件及其子节点文本。: After configuring the specified text, both the component and its child node texts are checked.
模糊匹配会忽略换行和连续空白差异，只要规范化后的文本包含目标内容即可。: Fuzzy matching ignores line breaks and consecutive whitespace differences as long as the normalized text contains the target content.
精准匹配要求 Appium 返回的完整文本与指定文本完全一致。: An exact match requires that the complete text returned by Appium exactly matches the specified text.
分支可以包含多个连续步骤，也可以在分支末尾连接其他脚本。: A branch can contain multiple consecutive steps, or additional scripts can be connected at the end of the branch.
只出现一次的引导弹窗。: A boot popup that only appears once.

展开节点，在“指定文本”中输入该弹窗特有的文案。: Expand the node and enter the unique copy of the pop-up window in "Specify text".

Device operations on this page and manual orchestration are locked during generation, saving and replay. Switching menus preserves the conversation and task. The live flow Execution Log shows only script replay; run results and elapsed time also appear in chat. AI orchestration progress appears in chat, and model-call details are saved with history. Clearing execution logs preserves AI orchestration history.
支持：启动 App、元素点击、覆盖输入（含中文）、清空、长按、四向滑动、返回/主: Supported actions include app launch, element taps, replacement input including Chinese, clearing, long press, four-direction swipes, Back/Home/Enter, short waits, element waits, text assertions, single-frame or continuous AI recognition, paired screen comparisons, timing markers and logs. Only linear flows are generated. AI chooses tools from the goal and actual results, with no fixed routing by app or goal keywords. Stopping, failure or reaching a limit preserves completed steps for correction in the editor.
使用任务清单、当前子任务、历史结果和检查证据驱动决策，全部在本目录中使用 Typ: Decisions use the task list, current subtask, past results and verification evidence, implemented entirely in TypeScript in this directory. Both modes reuse the configured model. Pro validates plans against actual execution evidence without a separate multi-agent runtime.
模型首轮在动作中提供 plan 测试项（最多 20 项），之后用 taskId、: In the first action, the model supplies up to 20 test items in plan. Later actions use taskId, pageName and taskNote to identify the current task, actual page and brief factual progress. Plans describe test outcomes; navigation such as tapping and going back does not count as a completed test item. New items may be added, but existing goals cannot be deleted, renamed or weakened.
每轮按“观察当前页面 → 核对上一动作结果 → 更新任务进度 → 选择操作”决策: Each round observes the current page, checks the previous action, updates task progress and chooses an action. The program continuously supplies all pending, active and completed items, verification nodes, page visits and repeated routes. The full task ledger remains available within the generation task even when recent history is truncated.
assertText / assertExists 成功、AI 识别返回或画面比: Actual evidence is recorded for the current item only after assertText / assertExists succeeds, AI recognition returns, or a screen comparison finishes. In the next round, the model reads those results and confirms satisfied goals through completedTaskIds. Unsupported claims are rejected and replanned. A recognition or comparison result alone does not prove that a business goal passed; the model must assess the actual outcome.
同一 Activity 下结合可见节点识别不同页面，忽略数字时钟/计数变化、输入: Visible nodes distinguish pages within the same Activity while ignoring clock or counter changes, input contents and position changes. Page signatures are only hints; the model must still use current nodes and screenshots. Returning to an earlier page for a new test item is allowed. Repeating the same route twice without completing a new item prompts a change; four repetitions stop execution and retain the nodes. Three consecutive invalid task updates or unsupported completion attempts also stop execution.
只有所有测试项均有完成证据才允许结束；最后一项可由 finish 的当前真实节点: Execution may finish only when every test item has completion evidence. The final item can be checked against actual current nodes in finish. Every model input includes the task ledger; plans and completion records enter the existing history log. Replay runs an ordinary linear script without calling the planning model again. Existing AI recognition nodes continue to run as before.
右侧对话区顶部「历史对话」可查看、恢复、重命名或删除历史记录。每条记录右侧的编辑: Conversation History at the top of the right-hand chat area can view, restore, rename or delete records. The edit button beside each record sets its task title; later automatic saves preserve it without changing the linked script name. The current conversation is saved before starting or switching conversations. History can also restore a conversation after a page refresh.
独立数据库位于数据目录下的 .midscene-app/ai-conversat: The separate database .midscene-app/ai-conversations.sqlite under the data directory stores messages, app details, flow drafts, linked scripts, recent execution logs and status independently of the original script library.
每条需求下的「模型调用记录」可展开查看本次编排各轮规划/AI 识别的模型返回思考: Expand Model Call History below a request to view reasoning returned by the model in each planning or AI recognition round. Supported fields include reasoning_content, reasoning, text reasoning_details and <think> content in the response body. No additional reasoning is requested, and encrypted fields are not saved. Missing reasoning has an explicit empty state; old history is never fabricated. API keys are redacted from saved text. Invalid response formats still retain the returned content for diagnosis.
聊天中的记录入口显示为「用时 xx >」，统计该条需求各轮模型响应耗时之和；展开: The chat history entry appears as Elapsed xx > and totals model response times across the request's rounds. Expanding it shows only returned reasoning, excluding prompts, screenshots and raw response text. This is not device-event duration and does not include all screenshot, sampling or action time.
每轮实际发送的提示词与截图继续保存到同一历史库的 model_inputs /: Actual prompts and screenshots sent in each round remain in the same history database's model_inputs / model_images tables. Screenshots are deduplicated by content within a conversation; conversation snapshots store only request references. Chat details do not display these inputs. Sent inputs are retained on failure or cancellation, but authentication headers are never saved.
删除历史对话会要求确认，并清理该对话的模型请求、截图和关联测试脚本，测试编排列表: Deleting conversation history requires confirmation and removes its model requests, screenshots and linked test script, refreshing the test orchestration list. Scripts referenced by other conversations remain. The current conversation cannot be deleted during generation. Unsaved flows are archived first so a new conversation does not discard them.
本功能加入前未持久化的旧对话无法补回。设备实时预览和未提交给模型的采样帧不另外归: Earlier conversations that were never persisted cannot be recovered. Live device preview and sampled frames not sent to the model are not separately archived. Logs retain the latest 200,000 characters and conversations the latest 200 messages.
页面步数设置已移除，服务端仍保留有界动作和总时限，防止异常无限执行。: The page no longer exposes a step-count setting. The server still enforces bounded actions and an overall time limit to prevent endless execution.
理解当前画面使用 AI 识别；分析过程或首次出现时间使用持续采样；比较两个时点的: Use AI recognition to understand the current screen, continuous sampling to analyze a process or first appearance, and paired screen comparison to compare a region at two times. A pixel change alone does not establish that a business event occurred.
对触发后立即观察的目标，模型可生成 2～8 步的连续操作段（最多一次设备交互），: For goals requiring immediate observation after a trigger, the model can generate 2–8 consecutive steps with at most one device interaction. All references are validated before execution. No model planning, component-tree reads or extra waits are inserted within the sequence. Output remains ordinary linear nodes that the existing editor can edit, save and replay.
持续观察可关联前面的开始计时节点。生成与回放均使用该计时起点标注截图时间；模型根: Continuous observation can reference an earlier Start Timer node. Generation and replay timestamp screenshots from that timer origin. The model answers using screenshot sampling times, never reasoning duration or the timer's final value. The End Timer log measures the entire sequence, including model analysis, and does not represent the first event's occurrence time.
首帧已命中只能给出时间上界；后续帧首次命中只能给出采样区间，精度受截图速度、采样: A match in the first frame gives only an upper time bound. A first match in a later frame gives a sampling interval. Accuracy depends on screenshot speed, sampling interval and automation overhead. Past events cannot be inferred backward; restore the initial state and trigger them again.
AI 识别配置中可编辑「观察时间原点」。关联计时器需通过完整流程启动，单独测试该: The AI recognition settings expose Observation Time Origin. Referenced timers require starting the full flow; testing that node alone cannot reconstruct the trigger time.
同一目标的反复点击不再因时钟等无关文字变化而重置计数；达到重复限制会停止并保留已: Unrelated text changes such as clocks no longer reset repeat-click counts for the same target. Reaching the repetition limit stops execution and preserves existing nodes.
执行时保存设备截图，独立于报告截图开关；敏感运行不保存截图文件。截图存于应用数据: Execution saves device screenshots independently of the report screenshot setting. Sensitive runs do not save screenshot files. Screenshots are stored under .midscene-app/screenshots in the application data root.
